sourceItems.title: China hikes half-year rare earth output quotas to record level
normalizedClaims: China raised H1 rare-earth mining quotas 27.2% YoY and smelting/separation quotas 27.6% to record levels, a supply response that could ease shortage pressure even as demand remained strong.

sourceItems.title: China rare earths extend surge on worries over Myanmar supply, inspection threat
normalizedClaims: China rare-earth price index had risen more than 40% from Oct 2020 to end-Jan and another 25% afterward; Myanmar supply concerns and domestic inspections added momentum while magnet-input prices approached decade highs.

sourceItems.title: Miners gear up global rare earth projects as prices surge
normalizedClaims: Rising rare-earth prices were encouraging global mine projects and diversification efforts, highlighting that high prices can induce a medium-term supply response.

sourceItems.title: Solar module prices rose by up to 15% in China
normalizedClaims: Chinese module prices rose 10-15% as shortages of polysilicon, glass, silver and frames pushed costs higher; industry commentary expected raw-material pressure to last months until new capacity ramped.

sourceItems.title: Cell prices not going up as module production further reduced
normalizedClaims: Mono-grade polysilicon traded mostly above RMB110/kg with almost no inventory available; prices had risen about 25% from pre-Lunar-New-Year levels.

sourceItems.title: Cell profits continue shrinking as upstream price increases show no sign of stopping
normalizedClaims: Polysilicon traded around RMB115-120/kg, another ~5% WoW increase, with insufficient inventory; downstream cell/module profits were being squeezed by upstream inflation.

sourceItems.title: Chinese PV Industry Brief: Polysilicon prices keep rising
normalizedClaims: Polysilicon reached about RMB124/kg and major product categories were up roughly 45% year-to-date; downstream cell pricing was already responding differently, showing value-chain divergence.
observedChanges: polysilicon Q1 price surge reaches extreme levels

sourceItems.title: Chip shortage forces Ford, Toyota, Nissan, FCA to cut vehicle production
normalizedClaims: Global semiconductor shortages forced several major automakers to cut January production after auto demand recovered faster than expected and foundry capacity was strained.
observedChanges: auto-chip shortage becomes a physical production bottleneck

sourceItems.title: 2021年3月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: March manufacturing PMI rose to 51.9; production 53.9 and new orders 53.6, showing broad post-holiday recovery.

eventClusters.statement: Rare-earth prices surged into near-decade highs on EV/magnet demand, Myanmar supply risk and inspections, while China simultaneously raised output quotas sharply and high prices encouraged new global projects. This creates a clean scarcity-versus-supply-response expectation-path test.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Price momentum is powerful, but domestic quota expansion and global project response can shorten the super-profit duration. Deep research must freeze both company cost/volume and the multi-year earnings path.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share rare-earth expression, if any, has durable volume/cost economics beyond a temporary PrNd price spike?

eventClusters.statement: Polysilicon shortages drove Q1 prices up roughly 25-45% and squeezed downstream cell/module economics; the value chain had a clear profit-pool shift toward upstream producers, but capacity expansion would eventually normalize scarcity.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Spot scarcity is real, but downstream pain and future capacity ramp mean current polysilicon prices cannot be extrapolated indefinitely. V1.2 should distinguish upstream durable cost/volume advantage from peak spot profits.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share polysilicon producer have enough structural cost/capacity advantage to justify a better outer-year path rather than only a Q1 price windfall?

eventClusters.statement: Automotive semiconductor scarcity became a global production bottleneck in January, forcing multiple OEMs to cut output. This is an early-stage physical shortage before the later 2021 equity rerating.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The shortage is real but company attribution can be wrong. Deep research must verify material auto-specific exposure and earnings conversion before selecting a stock.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Was there an A-share semiconductor supplier with auditable auto-specific earnings leverage before the later Q2/Q3 rerating?

eventClusters.statement: March manufacturing PMI rose to 51.9 with strong production and new orders, confirming broad post-holiday economic expansion.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Useful macro context, too broad for direct stock selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as regime context for commodity and semiconductor theses.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff rare-earth price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Rare-earth basket 20d excess -9.49pp and 60d +56.59pp; breadth 0%/100%; neutral. 北方稀土、盛和资源、五矿稀土 were all late_reversal: very strong 60d rerating followed by 20d relative weakness.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff polysilicon/PV price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: PV-upstream basket 20d excess -16.52pp and 60d -1.82pp; breadth 0%/33.3%; adverse. 通威 was de_rated on both 20d and 60d; 特变 was late_reversal; 隆基 was de_rated.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff automotive-semiconductor price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Auto-chip basket 20d excess -13.03pp and 60d -7.07pp; breadth 0%/33.3%; adverse. 斯达 and 士兰 were de_rated, while 韦尔 remained 60d positive but 20d negative.

evidenceDocuments.title: 盛和资源2020年度业绩预告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 盛和资源 via 财联社/公开公告
normalizedClaims: 盛和资源 expected 2020 attributable profit around RMB250-300m, +146%-195% YoY, as rare-earth prices and operating conditions improved.

evidenceDocuments.title: 盛和资源：高成长的稀土行业龙头
normalizedClaims: Forecast 2020E/2021E/2022E attributable profit RMB284m/1.079bn/1.501bn, growth +180%/+279.5%/+39.1%, with PE roughly 141x/37.2x/26.7x at the report price. The thesis already assumed a rare-earth demand upcycle and company growth.

evidenceDocuments.title: 通威股份：21年硅料价格上涨或将远超预期，量价齐升增厚公司业绩
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 新时代证券 via 新浪财经
normalizedClaims: Tongwei's polysilicon cash/production cost was estimated around RMB39.5/kg, 2021 effective capacity about 115k tonnes with orders largely locked, and 2020-22 profit forecast RMB4.57/6.61/7.04bn. The report explicitly expected 2021 polysilicon price/volume upside and assigned 45-50x 2021 PE in its target framework.
